content.title: Where to watch Warriors-Mavericks NBA game tonight livestream online
content.text: Published: Mar. 23, 2026, 5:00 p.m.Dallas Mavericks forward and Maine native Cooper Flagg during an NBA basketball game, March 6, 2026, in Boston. (AP Photo/Charles Krupa)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Thomas Lagrone | tlagrone@al.comThe Golden State Warriors play against the Dallas Mavericks in an NBA game tonight. The game is scheduled to begin at 8:30 p.m. CT on Peacock. Fans can watch this game live online by purchasing a monthly Peacock subscription for $10.99. The Warriors have struggled this season, as they enter this matchup with a 33-38 record. Notably, the team has lost three consecutive games. In their most recent matchup, the Warriors lost 126-110 against the Atlanta Hawks. In order to bounce back tonight, the Warriors will need a great performance from their guard Brandin Podziemski. He averages nearly 13 points per game, making him one of the top scorers for Golden State. The Warriors will have to play without Stephen Curry tonight due to injury. The Mavericks enter this matchup with a 23-48 record, and they have lost three games in a row. In their last game, the Mavericks lost 138-131 against the Los Angeles Clippers. In order to win the NBA game tonight, the Mavericks will need to rely on their forward Cooper Flagg. He leads the team in scoring this year, as he averages more than 20 points per game. Fans can watch this NBA game live online by purchasing a monthly Peacock subscription for $10.99.
